premise: Observer-accessible physical reality admits a faithful representation as a closed distributed typed transition system in which interactions update local process state, produce provenance-bearing transition certificates, and constrain future admissible transitions without an external interpreter or target-fitted consumer semantics.
plain_english: Reality is not software running on a separate computer. Its interactions are simultaneously the computation, the evidence that a transition occurred, and the change in what participating systems can do next.
standard_nulls: ordinary quantum process theory plus supplied instruments and observers
categorical classical structures plus supplied physical realization
decoherence, spectrum broadcast structure, and quantum Darwinism
causal event structures plus supplied scale and dynamics
distributed-systems analogy with no physical excess
anti_vacuity_rules: Computational describability alone earns no excess.
No external interpreter, scheduler, consumer, or semantic lookup table may be silently supplied.
No classical global state may be assumed where the quantum model supplies only contextual or noncommutative process structure.
Distributed-system theorems transfer only after exact timing, fault, identity, channel, and liveness assumptions are physically typed.
Graph, order, or recoverability data do not reconstruct metric scale without an independently selected scale-bearing relation.
A candidate advances only through a theorem, forbidden architecture, no-refit cross-arena law, or finite operational discriminator beyond its strongest null.

hypotheses.title: Closed causal operational sufficiency
hypotheses.statement: For a physically fixed observer boundary, the complete certified causal transition state together with the admitted action and resource envelope determines every observer-accessible response.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Does the proposed transition state add any independently selected structure beyond a complete process plus supplied action boundary?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: Two physically admitted completions have the same complete transition state, action envelope, and resources but different accessible responses, or the transition state is only a relabeling of the complete process.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Define target-independent adapters to the DU typed kernel and one quantum process specimen, then isolate at least one additional axiom with a theorem obligation.

hypotheses.title: Record-capability coformation
hypotheses.statement: A genuine physical record is a retained transition certificate whose formation target-blindly changes or stabilizes at least one future physical capability.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Can one physical interaction jointly select the write, certificate, and admitted continuation rather than merely correlate a carrier with a later supplied controller?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: Every candidate factorizes into a formed record plus an independently supplied consumer, or its capability change is ordinary feedback already fully captured by the standard process.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Produce a target-blind joint writer-consumer law or a scoped theorem showing why the factorization cannot be removed in the admitted class.

hypotheses.title: Classicality as physical composability
hypotheses.statement: The observer-accessible classical layer is the physically selected process substructure whose records can be copied, compared, transported, merged, and reused consistently under the declared action envelope.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Is there one physically selected maximal composable substructure, and does it coincide across algebraic copyability, operational mergeability, and material accessibility?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: Different equally lawful maximal composable substructures survive, or the claimed bridge reduces to a supplied pointer basis or strong-QD/SBS description.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: State the comparison category and morphisms, prove or refute maximality/naturality, and keep material formation and access separate.

hypotheses.title: Layered capability-relative finality
hypotheses.statement: Physical commitments can become safe for different actions at local, regional, and wider scales under distinct provenance, fault, rollback, and resource contracts rather than one scalar global finality rule.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Does a physically formed layered finality variable change a held-out response after the complete standard process and resource accounting are matched?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: Every layer is only a task-relative summary of the same physical process, with no transition delta beyond knowledge, reliability, or ordinary feedback.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Freeze one physical participant, event, fault, timing, resource, and action contract before importing a threshold or consensus result.

hypotheses.title: Geometry from causal access and recoverability
hypotheses.statement: Observer-accessible causal and geometric structure is reconstructible from a physically selected family of localized transitions, reachability relations, response records, and resource-calibrated recovery boundaries.
strongest_absorbers: quantum error correction and holographic reconstruction
hypotheses.decisive_question: Can a finite, physically selected, no-refit capability surface reconstruct held-out causal or conformal geometry, and what independently fixes metric scale?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: The same complete transition/recoverability object supports different held-out geometry, or the reconstruction imports the metric, scale, source family, or decoder it claims to recover.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Preserve the exact scale-gauge obstruction and require one independently formed scale-bearing mark plus finite response data.

hypotheses.title: Provenance-bearing event identity
hypotheses.statement: A complete action-relevant physical record includes enough causal lineage to distinguish formation, preload, copying, and reconstruction whenever those histories support different future actions.
hypotheses.decisive_question: When terminal values agree, does retained physical formation lineage enable a held-out action unavailable from the value alone?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: All admitted future responses factor through the terminal value once the complete standard state and environment are included.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Use same-value/different-history specimens with one frozen held-out action; authentication alone does not count as physical source formation.

hypotheses.title: Natural cross-layer selection
hypotheses.statement: A complete computation-first physical theory must target-blindly select the transition, certificate, access, and continuation interfaces or select one matched physical-gauge orbit across them.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Which complete handoff coordinates are constant on the candidate antecedent fibre, and which remain supplied?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: The supposed selector depends on the held-out target, or two inequivalent complete handoffs remain on one antecedent fibre.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Expose every adapter and free choice, quotient only matched full physical gauge, and prove selection or exact nonselection.

hypotheses.title: Dynamic sharding and access routing
hypotheses.statement: Subsystem and observer boundaries are dynamically selected routing and access structures that determine which transition certificates and operations are locally available without requiring one universally accessible global state.
hypotheses.decisive_question: Does the physical law select a boundary/routing structure with invariant consequences, or is every shard an analyst-chosen factorization?
hypotheses.cheapest_kill: Shard membership, routing, or observer boundary can be varied without changing any complete physical response, or is fitted to the target after the fact.
hypotheses.advancement_gate: Freeze boundary transformations, access actions, and held-out responses; distinguish physical relocation from descriptive repartitioning.

campaign.question: Which axioms of the minimal closed typed transition system add content beyond ordinary process theory and the existing DU typed kernel?
Do algebraic copyability, operational mergeability, and material accessibility select one classical substructure?
Can one physical interaction jointly select formation, provenance, and continuation capability?
Can physically selected regions compose capability-relative finality without importing digital consensus assumptions?
Can a finite selected transition and recoverability surface reconstruct held-out geometry with scale, then produce a theorem or excess beyond its nulls?
